summary.text: Katie Jones is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 61A, in office since 2025, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists no other candidate in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Katie Jones was born in Lebanon, Indiana, and graduated from Purdue University in 2010.
Her professional experience includes working as a community program and policy manager at the Center for Energy and Environment.

Jones's 2025-2026 committee assignments included the Climate and Energy Finance and Policy Committee, the House Transportation Finance and Policy Committee and the State Government Finance and Policy Committee.
